source_info.description: jiaaom 的 fnOS 应用仓库

en-US.name: jiaaom fygoOS repo
en-US.description: fnOS apps developed and maintained by jiaaom.

t6-drivers.desc: UnifyDrive UP6 / 极空间 T6 / PA60 的内核驱动（DKMS）：风扇、温度、LED、背光、蜂鸣器、按键、电池充电控制、触摸屏以及 HDMI 转 DSI 屏幕桥接。三件套中需第一个安装。

en-US.desc: Kernel drivers (DKMS) for the UnifyDrive UP6 / ZSpace T6 / PA60: fans, temperatures, LEDs, backlight, beeper, keys, battery charge control, touchscreen and HDMI-to-DSI panel bridge. Install this first.

1.4.0.changelog: 重启后屏幕亮度可以正确恢复（t6-platform 0.9.15：背光在 EC 就绪后才出现，systemd-backlight 的恢复不再失败）。

en-US.changelog: The screen brightness is restored correctly after a reboot (t6-platform 0.9.15: the backlight appears only once the EC is ready, so systemd-backlight's restore no longer fails).

2.0.0.changelog: 与 T6 前面板 2.0 一同发布，本身没有改动。

en-US.changelog: Released together with T6 Front Panel 2.0; no changes of its own.

2.1.0.changelog: 与 T6 前面板 2.1 一同发布，本身没有改动。

en-US.changelog: Released together with T6 Front Panel 2.1; no changes of its own.

t6-control.desc: UnifyDrive UP6 / 极空间 T6 的风扇曲线、LED、屏幕亮度、电池充电上限和蜂鸣器设置。需先安装 T6 驱动。

en-US.desc: Fan curves, LEDs, display brightness, battery charge limits and beeper of the UnifyDrive UP6 / ZSpace T6. Requires T6 Drivers.

1.4.0.changelog: 新增 remoted 服务：原装蓝牙遥控器（T2_remote_RC001）配对后可作为键盘使用（方向键、确定、返回、主页、菜单、音量、静音）；其他遥控器的键位映射可写在 /etc/remoted.toml。仪表盘显示遥控器连接状态、配对提示和按键测试（最后一次按键仅保留 5 分钟）。

en-US.changelog: New remoted service: the stock Bluetooth remote (T2_remote_RC001) works as a keyboard once paired (arrows, OK, Back, Home, Menu, volume, mute); key maps for other remotes go in /etc/remoted.toml. The dashboard shows the remote's connection, a pairing hint and a key test (the last key is kept for 5 minutes only).

1.4.1.changelog: 浏览器拦截插件挡住代理（例如 Cloudflare）额外插入的脚本时，Control Center 顶部不再显示“Page error”提示。

en-US.changelog: The Control Center no longer shows a "Page error" banner when a browser blocker stops a script added by a proxy such as Cloudflare.

2.0.0.changelog: 与 T6 前面板 2.0 一同发布，本身没有改动。

en-US.changelog: Released together with T6 Front Panel 2.0; no changes of its own.

2.0.1.changelog: fnOS 设为中文时页面恢复正常；自 1.2.0 起会停在“Page error”，不显示任何读数。

en-US.changelog: The page works again when fnOS is set to Chinese; since 1.2.0 it stopped with a "Page error" and showed no readings.

2.1.0.changelog: 与 T6 前面板 2.1 一同发布，本身没有改动。

en-US.changelog: Released together with T6 Front Panel 2.1; no changes of its own.

appliance-compositor.desc: 屏幕类应用共用的显示和声音服务：一个 Wayland 合成器（weston + appliance-shell）驱动所有屏幕，一个 PipeWire 声音服务。本身没有界面；T6 前面板、Fygo Cinema 等应用依赖它，需先安装。

en-US.desc: Shared display and sound server for screen apps: one Wayland compositor (weston + appliance-shell) on every display and one PipeWire sound server. No window of its own; apps such as T6 Front Panel and Fygo Cinema depend on it, so install it first.

1.0.0.changelog: 首个版本。weston 14 与 appliance-shell（按规则叠放窗口、单窗口旋转、控制接口）以及 appliance-screensaver，接管自 T6 前面板；PipeWire、WirePlumber 和 pipewire-pulse 以系统级服务运行。各应用在 /etc/appliance-compositor/clients.d 中登记自己的窗口和屏幕。缺少时自动从 bookworm-backports 安装 weston 14、Mesa 24 和 PipeWire；装有 PulseAudio 时拒绝安装。

en-US.changelog: First release. weston 14 with appliance-shell (window stacking by rule, per-window rotation, control socket) and appliance-screensaver, taken over from T6 Front Panel; PipeWire, WirePlumber and pipewire-pulse run system-wide. Apps register their windows and outputs in /etc/appliance-compositor/clients.d. Installs weston 14, Mesa 24 and PipeWire from bookworm-backports when missing; refused while PulseAudio is installed.

1.1.0.changelog: 按优先级分配键盘焦点：应用可在运行期间独占键盘和遥控器（规则键 focus-priority），例如前面板进入屏保时，电视应用仍保有遥控器。窗口可以不重启合成器直接移到另一块屏幕（控制命令 set-output），屏幕稍后接上时窗口也会自动移过去。屏幕未连接时，窗口可以保持隐藏，而不是出现在其他应用的屏幕上（规则键 output-fallback=none）。

en-US.changelog: Keyboard focus by priority: an app can keep the keyboard and remote while it runs (rule key focus-priority), so a TV app keeps the remote even when the front panel's screensaver is up on the other screen. Windows can move to another screen without restarting the compositor (control command set-output), and move to their screen when it is connected later. A window whose screen is not connected can stay hidden instead of opening on another app's screen (rule key output-fallback=none).

1.1.1.changelog: 修复：重启后屏幕可能一直黑着。显示服务在开机画面（Plymouth）期间启动，拿不到显示器；现在会等开机画面结束后再启动。

en-US.changelog: Fix: after a reboot the screens could stay dark. The compositor started under the boot splash (Plymouth) and could not take the displays; it now waits for the splash to end.

t6-panel.desc: UnifyDrive UP6 / 极空间 T6 前置触摸屏应用：总览、文件管理、网络连接和设备设置，内置视频和音乐播放器。需先安装 T6 控制中心和 Appliance Compositor。

en-US.desc: Front touch-screen app for the UnifyDrive UP6 / ZSpace T6: overview, files, network and device settings, and a built-in video and music player. Requires T6 Control Center and Appliance Compositor.

1.4.0.changelog: 支持遥控器和键盘操作：方向键移动焦点框，确定打开，返回、主页、菜单在所有页面可用，音量键调节音量（视频播放器中同样适用）。熄屏时屏幕会拦截所有按键和触摸：按键或双击唤醒，音量键不唤醒。屏幕关闭前淡出、唤醒时淡入，淡出过程中按键可取消熄屏。

en-US.changelog: Remote and keyboard control: the arrow keys move a focus ring, OK opens, Back, Home and Menu work everywhere, and the volume keys set the volume, including in the video player. While the screen is dark it takes every key and touch: a key or a double tap wakes it, the volume keys don't. The screen fades to black before switching off and fades back in; a key during the fade cancels the switch-off.

1.4.1.changelog: 显示和声音服务改由新的 Appliance Compositor 应用提供（需先安装），可与其他屏幕应用（例如在电视上运行的 Fygo Cinema）共用；前面板、视频播放器和屏保仍显示在内置屏幕上。屏幕键盘的回车键会执行文件搜索并收起键盘，不再误点焦点框所在的按钮。

en-US.changelog: The screen and sound server now come from the new Appliance Compositor app (install it first), shared with other screen apps such as Fygo Cinema on a TV; the panel, its video player and screensaver stay on the built-in screen. The on-screen keyboard's return key runs the Files search and closes the keyboard, instead of clicking whatever the focus ring was on.

1.4.2.changelog: Ethernet 磁贴会显示任一已连接的有线网卡，包括 USB 网卡；Ethernet 页面列出每张网卡（未连接的也列出），每张都可单独设置 IPv4。开关色彩校正不再重启屏幕，改为保存后在 NAS 重启后生效（以前重启屏幕可能导致黑屏直到重启）。

en-US.changelog: The Ethernet tile shows any connected wired adapter, including USB ones, and the Ethernet page lists every adapter, connected or not, each with its own IPv4 settings. Turning color correction on or off no longer restarts the screen; it is saved and applies after the NAS restarts (restarting the screen could leave it black until a reboot).

2.0.0.changelog: 全新外观和布局（Ridgeline 设计系统），支持中文和英文，默认浅色主题。总览以一张本机线描图开头，标注处理器、内存、温度、网口和存储读数；顶部的状态行一眼告诉你是否一切正常，有问题时点一下直达。文件：最多三个标签页，复制和移动在后台进行，文件图标按类型着色，文件夹大小在对话框里计算；退出登录会关闭打开的文件夹并清空剪贴板和最近文件。连接：连接地图，Wi-Fi 可加入企业（802.1X）网络，热点和本机地址都有二维码。屏幕闲置后先变暗（1–15 分钟，降到亮度的 10%、25% 或 50%，一碰即恢复），再熄屏（1、12、24 小时或从不）；原来的熄屏时间会转为变暗时间。设置新增声音和关于页面；SSH 开关前会先确认；遥控器的主页键在四个标签之间切换。不再提供日文。

en-US.changelog: A new look and layout (Ridgeline design system), in Chinese and English, light by default. Overview opens with a drawing of the NAS labelled with its processor, memory, temperature, network and storage readings; a status line says whether all is well and opens the problem when it isn't. Files: up to three tabs, copies and moves in the background, file icons in colour by type, folder size in a dialog; signing out closes the open folders and clears the clipboard and recent files. Network: a connection map, Wi-Fi joins enterprise (802.1X) networks, QR codes for the hotspot and the NAS's address. When idle the screen first dims (after 1–15 minutes, to 10, 25 or 50 % of its brightness; a touch brings it back), then turns off (after 1, 12 or 24 hours, or never); the old screen timeout carries over as the dimming time. Settings adds Sound and About pages; SSH asks before it changes; the remote's Home key steps through the four tabs. Japanese is no longer offered.

2.0.2.changelog: 标签栏白天改为靛青布面，当前项是一张缃色签条，远处也一眼找到；夜间当前项是靛青签条。状态栏把正在用的连接并排显示：蓝牙、Wi-Fi 或热点、有线。设置 › 屏幕 合成一行「闲置」，点进去设变暗和熄屏。英文界面下，文件里后排标签的名字在边缘淡出，不再从单词中间截断。

en-US.changelog: The tab bar is indigo cloth by day, with the current tab on a pale straw-yellow label that is easy to find from across the room; at night it is an indigo label. The status bar shows every connection in use side by side: Bluetooth, Wi-Fi or the hotspot, and wired. Settings › Screen has one Idle row that opens a page for dimming and turning the screen off. In English, the names of tabs behind in Files fade out instead of being cut mid-word.

2.1.0.changelog: 主题可以跟随夜间：在 设置 › 外观 选「跟随夜间」，再设定夜间时段（默认 22:00–07:00，可以跨过午夜）。控制中心的 夜案 会临时换成另一种主题，到夜间时段下一次切换时恢复跟随。夜间时段 和 变暗到 现在缩进在所属的设置下面。

en-US.changelog: The theme can follow the night: in Settings › Appearance choose At night and set its hours (22:00–07:00 by default, across midnight if you like). Night desk in the control center switches to the other theme until the night hours next change, then the schedule takes over again. Night hours and Dim to now sit indented under the setting they belong to.

2.1.1.changelog: 修复面板运行越久、滑动越卡的问题：运行一天左右后，所有页面滑动都会卡顿。

en-US.changelog: Scrolling no longer gets slower the longer the panel runs; after a day or so every page stuttered.

fygo-cinema.desc: 直连电视看飞牛影视：NAS 自带的飞牛影视网页版全屏显示在接到 NAS 的电视上，用遥控器操作，视频硬件解码。自动登录，插上电视即启动，声音从电视扬声器播放。需先安装飞牛影视和 Appliance Compositor。

en-US.desc: Fygo TV on your TV: the NAS's own Fygo TV web app fullscreen on a TV plugged into the NAS, driven by a remote, with hardware video decoding. Signs in by itself, starts when the TV is plugged in and plays through the TV's speakers. Requires Fygo TV and Appliance Compositor.

1.0.0.changelog: 首个版本。飞牛影视全屏显示在电视上，用遥控器操作：每个页面都有方向键导航和焦点框，支持确定和返回；播放器中上 / 下键呼出控制栏（倍速、清晰度、字幕、音轨）。硬件解码最高 4K HDR。使用管理页填写的账户自动登录，重启后保持登录；没有账户或登录失败时，电视上会显示下一步操作和二维码，不会黑屏。插上电视即启动、拔下即停止；声音从电视扬声器播放，遥控器音量键调节电视音量并显示音量条。页面大小按屏幕调整（高于 1080p 为 200%，否则为 150%，可修改）。遥控器碰不到管理和账户相关的按钮。

en-US.changelog: First release. Fygo TV fullscreen on the TV, driven by a remote: arrow-key navigation with a focus ring on every page, OK and Back; in the player, up/down bring up the controls (speed, quality, subtitles, audio track). Hardware video decoding up to 4K HDR. Signs in by itself with the account entered on the admin page and stays signed in across restarts; without an account, or when sign-in fails, the TV shows what to do with a QR code instead of a black screen. Starts when the TV is plugged in and stops when it is unplugged; plays through the TV's speakers; the remote's volume keys set the TV volume with an on-screen display. The page is sized for the screen (200 % above 1080p, 150 % otherwise, adjustable). Admin and account controls are hidden from the remote.

1.1.0.changelog: Fygo Cinema 运行期间，遥控器始终留在电视上，前面板熄屏时也一样（需要 Appliance Compositor 1.1）。把电视改插到另一个接口，或在管理页换一块电视屏幕时，不再重启显示服务，其他屏幕不受影响（需要 Appliance Compositor 1.1；旧版仍会重启）。电视拔掉期间，它的窗口不会出现在其他屏幕上。拔掉电视时，电视应用会正常退出。

en-US.changelog: The remote stays with the TV while Fygo Cinema runs, also when the front panel's screen goes dark (needs Appliance Compositor 1.1). Moving the TV to another port, or choosing another TV screen on the admin page, no longer restarts the display server, so the other screens are not interrupted (with Appliance Compositor 1.1; older ones are still restarted). While the TV is unplugged its window never shows on another screen. Unplugging the TV now stops the TV app cleanly.

1.1.1.changelog: 修复：重启后电视可能黑屏只剩一条线、遥控器没反应。电视应用比飞牛影视先启动，停在了服务器的错误页；现在会显示“正在连接 Fygo TV…”，飞牛影视就绪后自动进入。页面加载后没有焦点框时也会自动补上。建议同时升级 Appliance Compositor 1.1.1。

en-US.changelog: Fix: after a reboot the TV could stay black with a thin line and the remote seemed dead. The TV app started before Fygo TV was ready and kept the server's error page; it now shows "Connecting to Fygo TV…" and goes on by itself once Fygo TV is up. The focus ring also comes back by itself if a page loads without one. Appliance Compositor 1.1.1 is recommended too.

1.1.2.changelog: 电视端不再把播放过的视频缓存到系统盘（看几部片就是几百 MB，而且从不复用）；升级时会自动删除旧缓存。

en-US.changelog: The TV app no longer fills the system disk with a cache of the videos it played (hundreds of MB after a few films, never reused); the old cache is removed on upgrade.

1.1.3.changelog: 在 FygoOS 手机 App 中，管理页面能完整显示在手机屏幕上；以前右侧会被截掉（开关、电视卡片、移除按钮和下拉菜单）。

en-US.changelog: The admin page fits a phone screen in the FygoOS mobile app; before, its right side was cut off (the switch, the TV tile, the Remove button and the dropdowns).
